content.value: . A project was started about twelve years ago. Initial investment of this project (12) was 100000 TK. The project earned 120000 TK at the year of nine. Total maintenance cost was about 60000 TK at the year of eleven. Now evaluate the project at the year of twelve using any criteria of cost-benefit ratio considering time value of money. Assume interest rate of this project is 15%.
